question_text: Describe how an algorithm using row index r and column index c can recognize a main-diagonal entry in a square two-dimensional list.
adaptation_rationale: 2Dindexrelationshipwithinlistalgorithms. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
solution: Compare r and c; if the row equals the column, the element is on main diagonal; otherwise it is not.

marking_points.criterion: Uses r == c as the main-diagonal criterion.
